title: sphaerocephalus viscosus
intro: Sphaerocephalus viscosus, commonly known as sticky skullcap, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce pain, inflammation, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Sphaerocephalus viscosus include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant and anti-cancer properties, and show promise in the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
